entries.reason: EnablerPayoffPairings.Parse requires the root object itself to be the payoff -> [enablers] map (src/FusionRpg.Core/Actions/Seeding/EnablerPayoffPairings.cs:47-48); wrapping it in a kind+entries envelope would make the parser throw. Never rewritten by this loader — read-only.

ActionNameTemplates.Parse reads base/modifiers directly off the root object and rejects a missing or non-object key (src/FusionRpg.Core/Actions/Seeding/ActionNameTemplates.cs:68-70,83-84); wrapping it in an envelope would make the parser throw. Never rewritten by this loader — read-only.

A-S0's species -> family-id projection (53 species over 19 family ids). A flat map, not a kind+entries envelope, so it is declared config rather than corpus content — same as the two files above, just under a LOADED prefix rather than the root. Read fresh by this adapter's vocab.load_family_map_keys() for the family-scoped scopeKey cross-check; never rewritten.

A-S3's survivors and A-S6's promotions mint the SAME action.*/reject.*/review.* grammar under one root as the committed corpus, so a duplicate id is structurally guaranteed the moment A-S6 promotes (spec-corpus-loader.md §3 step 2b, review F14). The only prefix where that is true.
pool.*/lean.*/weights.* -- none of them action.* -- and a re-derivation overwrites its own file in place, so it cannot collide with a promoted seed.
brief.* only, and a brief's avoidNeighbours.actionId edge only resolves if both ends load into one graph.
cell.*/target.* only, and a coverage cell naming its subject is the other cross-kind edge the per-kind id_pattern table exists for.

A-P1/A-P2/A-P3's own pre-acceptance scratch rows (spec: 'Never write into data/seed/actions/ -- acceptance is A-S3's; persistence is A-S6's'). Rows key on candidateId, not this corpus's own id grammar, and carry no cross-reference another committed entry resolves against -- the same 'safer to exclude than to guess' default `_load_committed_corpus` already states for any undeclared prefix, made explicit here now that a real run has populated this directory for the first time.
